summary: Keep the task as a fresh exact deferral. Direct Rowan, Texas and Quinbrook evidence resolves Rowan Temple as the subordinate Phase 1 campus of Rowan Digital Infrastructure and identifies Rowan Temple LLC as a project owner or operator, making the standalone source record a likely future supersession candidate into cmrxpjmr2018livhe1yqhqyh5. Direct government, court, Quinbrook, UPP, GLEIF and recapitalization evidence resolves several legal entities and disclosed investor relationships but not the complete Temple member chain, the legal bridge between Rowan Green Data LLC and Rowan Digital Infrastructure LLC, the exact recap issuer, the complete direct-owner ledger, UPP's post-recap disposition, Blackstone's exact percentage and vehicle, Quinbrook's retained stake, votes and control, or any separately governed project equity. Do not infer a complete ownership after-image and do not apply the merge.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The current direct Rowan page identifies Temple as a Rowan campus in Temple, Texas with approximately 700 acres, 300 MW, construction beginning in late 2025 and a 2027 target.
Current Texas data-center records distinguish the older Temple Green Data Center / Rowan Moriah LLC / Rhodium relationship from the later Rowan Temple LLC / Polmer project roles.

The direct Quinbrook 2023 page establishes the 2020 Quinbrook-Birch venture origin and describes Rowan as wholly owned by Quinbrook by January 2023, proving Birch is former by that date without proving transfer mechanics.

The current Texas franchise-tax API returns a 2023 Public Information Report naming QIP Rowan Series A LLC, PEP Development Services LLC and Rowan Management Co LLC as members, but that report is stale and contains no stakes or upstream owner chain.
The direct UPP page proves a completed 2024 co-investment but does not disclose terms or post-recapitalization treatment.

The direct 2026 recapitalization release proves that Blackstone-affiliated funds acquired a significant minority stake and that Quinbrook remained involved through its chairman, but not the complete post-close cap table.
Current GLEIF records identify separate active Rowan Green Data LLC and Rowan Digital Infrastructure LLC entities, with 2020 and 2025 creation dates, rather than proving a simple rename.

identityResolution.boundary: Treat Rowan Temple and Project Temple as subordinate Phase 1 campus labels within the Rowan platform; Temple is distinct from Stampede Phase 2, Ranger Phase 3 and the older Temple Green / Moriah project. Rowan Temple LLC is identified as a project owner or operator, while Rowan Temple Building 2 LLC, Rowan Temple Mezzco LLC and Rowan Temple 2 LLC roles remain unresolved. Do not treat occupants, operators, lenders, utilities, tax authorities, land counterparties, contractors or financing vehicles as Rowan equity owners.

verifiedRelationships.quinbrook: The platform originated through the Quinbrook-Birch venture, was described as wholly owned by Quinbrook by January 2023 and remained involved through Quinbrook's Rowan chairman after the 2026 recapitalization. QIP Rowan Series A LLC appears in the 2023 Public Information Report, but its upstream fund chain and cutoff holder, stake, votes, governance and control remain unresolved.
verifiedRelationships.birch: Birch Infrastructure PBLLC participated in the 2020 venture and is former by the January 2023 wholly owned Quinbrook description. A 2026 filed petition alleges a transfer to Rowan Management Co LLC and later divestiture and seeks rescission, but executed transfer terms, exact exit date and current legal effect remain unresolved.
verifiedRelationships.upp: UPP completed a Rowan co-investment announced 2024-08-13. No direct evidence proves whether UPP retained, sold, rolled, diluted or transferred its Rowan equity in the 2026 recapitalization.
verifiedRelationships.blackstone: Blackstone-affiliated funds acquired an unspecified significant minority stake by 2026-04-09. The exact percentage, denominator, acquiring vehicle, security, sellers, primary-secondary mix, votes, governance and exact legal closing date remain unresolved.
verifiedRelationships.temple: No separately governed Temple project-equity co-owner was disclosed, but tax records do not certify the Rowan Temple LLC member and intermediate-parent chain.

rejectedInferences: Do not infer Rowan Temple LLC members from tax owner or operator labels, project branding, building entities, borrower roles or platform affiliation.
Do not treat the 2023 Public Information Report as a current 2026 owner ledger or infer stakes and upstream ownership from its three member names.
Do not infer a rename or parent-child bridge between Rowan Green Data LLC and Rowan Digital Infrastructure LLC merely from GLEIF existence dates or similar names.
Do not infer UPP retention or exit from transaction-party silence.
Do not infer Quinbrook control from continuing involvement, chairmanship, fund exposure or portfolio continuity.
Do not infer 49 percent, Blackstone's vehicle, seller identity or governance from secondary reporting when absent from the direct transaction-party release.
Do not treat pleaded Birch allegations as adjudicated title or proof that rescission restored equity.
Do not allocate residual ownership, create a partial owner after-image or apply project-to-platform supersession while the complete active-owner rule is unsatisfied.

operatingResolution.commercialName: Rowan Temple / Project Temple / Temple Phase 1
operatingResolution.disclosedOperatingBoundary: Project Temple is a three-building campus of approximately 700 acres and 300 MW. Construction began in late 2025, and Rowan identifies a 2027 target. It is distinct from the broader six-building 1.6 GW program and the older Moriah project. No energization, commissioning or operating commencement was verified.
operatingResolution.vehicleTreatment: Project owners, operators, occupants, lenders, tax counterparties, utilities, land counterparties, contractors and financing relationships are not duplicate Rowan platforms or proven company-level equity owners.

transactionResolution.finding: Blackstone-affiliated funds acquired a significant minority stake on or before the 2026-04-09 announcement, while Quinbrook remained involved through its managing partner's Rowan chairmanship. The exact legal closing date, issuer, holder vehicle, security, percentage, denominator, sellers, UPP treatment, votes, governance and control are not publicly disclosed in the reopened direct sources.
transactionResolution.nonEquityBoundary: The May 2026 $3 billion Rowan financing is debt. Temple construction debt, tax incentives, leases, land, permits, utility arrangements and vendor relationships do not establish Rowan platform equity or later ownership transactions.

applicationRequirements: Use a terminal-only DEFERRED outcome and do not supersede the standalone Rowan Temple source record while the project member chain, legal-entity bridge, exact recap issuer and complete active-owner after-image remain unavailable.
Preserve the verified Temple project-to-Rowan platform hierarchy, legal-entity clues, historic filed member names and disclosed investor relationships as research lineage.

Do not infer Temple LLC members, current status of the 2023 filed members, Rowan Green-to-Digital legal continuity, 49 percent, UPP retention or exit, Quinbrook control, seller identity, holder vehicles, fund attribution, residual ownership, Birch's executed disposition or project-level co-ownership.
Do not elevate the project SPVs, occupants, operators, lenders, tax authorities, utilities, land counterparties, contractors or financing vehicles into duplicate Rowan company records or owners.

Use exactly one application primary citation bound to the fresh direct recapitalization page bytes and retain the other six returned sources and supplemental GLEIF source as supporting research lineage.
